events.summary: Jace studies the abstract memories of the Iquati and finds ideas to improve upon.
events.quote: In the abstract memories of the Iquati, Jace found interesting ideas to improve upon.

events.summary: Vraska taunts Jace that he cannot protect everyone.
Vraska tells Jace he cannot think his way out of this.
events.quote: "You can't think your way out of this, Jace.

relations.quote: "You can't think your way out of this, Jace.
